svg.aria-label: Implemented MTS Mock Assessment end-to-end process flow with six responsibility swimlanes
svg.title: MTS Mock Assessment — implemented end-to-end workflow
svg.desc: Six vertical lanes show human, AI, orchestrator, code, storage and external printing responsibilities across PreRun, Run and PostRun. Exact reviewed baselines may reuse completed reviews. Otherwise fresh review and repair are required. All mandatory criteria and explicit human approval precede production release.

g.text: MTS | Mock Assessment — end-to-end process flow
Implemented historical source-based benchmarks · Math Grades 4/5 + ELA Grade 6
76/76 mandatory verified · current position: human review · no production publication
Repair loop: render and check again
Explicit approval of both PDF hashes
Blue: activity · Amber diamond: gate · Green: verified result · Amber return arrows: repair / stop / recovery
Weekly Practice stays independent. Broader diagnostic, custom and generated modes remain deferred.
No production release without artifact-specific human approval. Printing remains external; live Drive publication has not been performed.
